title: Fix dashboard stats cards navigating to a 404 page
body:
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 -->


Clicking a stats card on the dashboard (failed, queued, running, or active Dags) navigated to a 404 page instead of the filtered Dags list.


## Cause
The stats cards used route-relative links such as `dags?dag_run_state=running`. These resolved correctly only when the dashboard was rendered at the index route (/).

Now that the dashboard can also be rendered at /home, the same relative links resolve against `/home` and point to `/home/dags?....` That route does not exist and returns a 404.

The issue only reproduces when the dashboard is opened at /home, for example via the "Dashboard" navigation button. When the dashboard is rendered at `/`, the relative links happen to resolve correctly, which is why the issue went unnoticed.
